Subject: Request to revive paused sandbox + one-off promo top-up for extended eval

Hi Irene / Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at NovaCorp is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile. We had a trial sandbox that recently expired (account: novacorp-eval) and our engineering lead hit the token limit while running a long-form summarization eval. That process is paused and we need a short runway to finish quality checks.

Would Redwood be able to:
- Reactivate the sandbox (same project/account) for 7 days
- Provide a one-off promo top-up (~50k tokens or equivalent) so our eval completes end-to-end

I attached the trial logs that show the eval cut off abruptly (trial_logs_novacorp.csv). We're on a tight timeline — aim to conclude by next Friday. Happy to provide any account details or PO info you need.

Also, our security team will want a SOC2 summary — can you point me to the right doc?

Appreciate any help to avoid re-running this from scratch.

Best,
Sam
VP of Product | NovaCorp

2) Can you confirm the exact project id (we have two close matches: novacorp-eval and novacorp-eval-2026)?
3) We'll also attach a short SOC2 summary and a DocuSign approval for the promo allocation once approved.

If you can confirm the project id, I'll loop in Marissa (reviews credits exceptions) and Aditya (technical handoff) to push this through today.

On the logs — thanks, I attached them to this thread for internal review.
